takes.h: Weird House Press: Halloween grab bags and new titles
takes.p: Weird House Press lists its 2026 Halloween Grab Bags as shipping. Its catalog also carries Elizabeth Massie's Welcome Back to the Night and titles by Brian Evenson and Richard Gavin. The pages give no publication dates, so check the listings for each book.

takes.h: Funko adds Scream and Halloween II vinyl toys
takes.p: Funko has announced vinyl toys of Sidney, Gale and Dewey from Scream, and Michael Myers, Laurie Strode and Dr. Loomis from Halloween II, according to Bloody Disgusting's toy coverage.

takes.h: Samhain gets a Funko Pop, limited to 1,000
takes.p: Dread Central reports that Samhain, the villain of The Real Ghostbusters, is getting a Funko Pop limited to 1,000 pieces.

takes.h: Other Worlds Than These closes the Talisman trilogy
takes.p: Stephen King and Peter Straub's Other Worlds Than These, the third and final Talisman book, came out from Scribner on October 6. It runs 624 pages and carries 38 black-and-white illustrations by Gabriel Rodríguez. The audiobook is narrated by Patton Oswalt.
